title: Kenyan Nectarine Crisp
description: A sweet and tangy dessert that combines the flavors of Kenyan spices with the sweetness of nectarines. The effervescent element adds a refreshing twist to this classic crisp.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together sliced nectarines, granulated sugar, and Kenyan spice blend.
Soak the mixture in effervescent water for 10 minutes.
In a separate bowl, mix together flour, oat flour, and melted unsalted butter.
Transfer the nectarine mixture to a baking dish and top with the flour mixture.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the topping is golden brown and the filling is bubbly.
Serve warm with a scoop of vanilla ice cream if desired.
